title: Enforcement and Litigation
short: Infringement and passing off actions before the Commercial Courts and the Intellectual Property Divisions of the High Courts.
intro: When a mark is copied, the brand owner needs two things quickly: an honest assessment of the case and a remedy proportionate to the harm. We provide both. Many matters are resolved by a well-drafted letter and a negotiated undertaking. Those that are not are pursued in court with the record already prepared.

We conduct suits for infringement and passing off, seek and resist interim injunctions, and handle the pre-institution mediation, appeals and execution that follow. We also advise defendants who have received a notice or been sued, where the right answer is often a considered response rather than capitulation.
services: Investigations, cease-and-desist notices and negotiated undertakings
Suits for infringement and passing off before the Commercial Courts and High Courts
Interim and ex parte injunctions, Anton Piller and John Doe orders, local commissioner appointments
Pre-institution mediation under Section 12A of the Commercial Courts Act
Defence of infringement and passing off claims, including groundless threats actions
Dilution, trade dress, comparative advertising and disparagement claims
Appeals before Division Benches and the Supreme Court through counsel
Execution of decrees, damages and costs, and enforcement of settlement terms

process.title: Case assessment
process.text: A written opinion on the strength of the rights, the evidence of confusion and the remedies realistically available.

process.title: Notice and negotiation
process.text: Where appropriate, a notice drafted to secure an undertaking rather than a reply from a litigator.

process.title: Institution
process.text: Pleadings and evidence prepared to the standard of the first hearing, because the first hearing often decides the matter.

process.title: Conduct and closure
process.text: Active case management through interim orders, trial and appeal, with regular reporting to the client.
